name: pulsating-button
title: Pulsating Button
description: A pair of buttons that keep throwing a blurred halo outwards to pull the eye. One variant swells and shrinks the ring, the other sends it out and lets it fade.
use: One primary action must keep pulling the eye, such as a waitlist or launch signup.
avoid: Pages with several actions, or calm interfaces: the loop never stops and competes for attention.
a11y: The halo is hidden from assistive tech, but the perpetual pulse ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded rectangles sit side by side on black: an indigo button with white text and a white button with dark text. Each is ringed by a soft halo wider than the button, tinted with its own colour.
behaves: The halo spreads out from the button edge and fades, then repeats on a fixed duration, without stopping. The pulse variant grows and shrinks symmetrically, while the ripple variant pushes the ring out until it disappears.
customise: The label is passed as children; halo colour, duration, spread distance and the pulse or ripple variant are props, while size and base colours come from className.
weight: light: One CSS box-shadow keyframe on a decorative span, with no scripted animation loop.
